results.json.decision: Reject after stage 1: median total style computation for the normal pair of charts is 36.4 microseconds. Even complete removal of every style call is negligible relative to rendering. Timing variance prevents a precise speedup claim, but the largest observed baseline batch is still below 0.6 milliseconds. A process-global cache also retains repository labels and adds state/palette mutation complexity.
limitations: Microbenchmark samples show substantial host noise; no precise cache speedup or whole-render speedup is established.
